name: Stack Tower 3D
description: Stack sliding blocks as high as you can: overhangs are cut off and tumble down, perfect drops grow your tower.
prompt: A 3D stacking game with three.js: blocks slide in from alternating sides, I tap to drop them, the part that overhangs is cut and falls, perfect drops give combos and grow the block back, rainbow colours and a camera that rises with the tower.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Apila bloques que se deslizan lo más alto que puedas: lo que sobresale se corta y cae, y los encajes perfectos hacen crecer tu torre.
